definitions: To have a private reason for doing or being involved in something, especially a selfish motive or a complaint.
To have a personal grievance or a hidden agenda.
examples: He seems to have an axe to grind with the new manager.
I suspect she has an axe to grind, which is why she's so critical.
Don't trust his advice; he always has an axe to grind.
lemma: to have an axe to grind
synonyms: to have a bone to pick
to have a chip on one's shoulder
source: to have an axe to grind
